description: Golden set for evaluating EU-MDR retrieval and citation. 'question' items are sent to retrieval as-is (same as POST /retrieve). 'narrative' items are adverse event narratives with a given MAUDE label and go through the label-steered retrieval used by POST /assess. expected_sections lists every section accepted as correct, by its header prefix (e.g. 'Article 87').
status: REVIEWED - expected_sections are reviewed against the regulation text. Results can be published
